parameters.name: denoiseStart
parameters.description: accumulated sample count at which denoising starts; negative values count back from sampleLimit (-1 == only the final frame)

parameters.name: denoiseMode
parameters.description: requested denoiser guides; eligible reference media force effective color-only denoising with a warning when guides are requested; public albedo and normal remain available

parameters.name: volumeSamplingRate
parameters.description: finite primary-volume quadrature rate relative to field resolution or domain fallback; larger rates refine anchored cells; 1 is an experimental qualification starting point, not a measured latency optimum

parameters.name: volumeSamplingRateShadows
parameters.description: finite shadow-volume quadrature rate relative to field resolution or domain fallback; larger rates refine anchored cells; 1 is an experimental qualification starting point, not a measured latency optimum

parameters.name: cutPlane
parameters.description: cutting plane equation (nx, ny, nz, d); disabled when all zero (vec4(0))
